receipts.first_text_witness: You're sitting in your car in the work parking lot, not because you forgot something, because you opened your banking app while the engine was still running. It's just a quick check, 30 seconds, and now you need a moment before you go in.
receipts.last_text_witness: bigger than their paycheck. That's the crossover and it doesn't happen to lucky people. It happens to people who treated a $5,000 raise like it didn't exist, opened a brokerage app instead of an apartment listing, and then waited long enough for the math to catch up. You can't rush compound interest, but you absolutely can start it. And starting it today is worth more than starting it perfectly tomorrow.
